clauses.requirement: Daytime running lamps (RL) shall meet the luminous intensities of Table 6 (Par. 4.8.3.1.): minimum luminous intensity 4.00∙10² cd; maximum luminous intensity 1.20∙10³ cd (Par. 4.8.3.1.(b)); a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) maximum 6.00∙10² cd; standard light distribution per Figure A3-II and Table A2-1; minimum luminous intensity for the angles of geometric visibility 1.0∙10⁰ cd.

Where the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp is intended to be reduced per paragraph 6.19.7. of the 08 or any subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 48, the reduced designed maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.40∙10² cd; the light of each of the two samples supplied shall meet Table 6.
The daytime running lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility as specified in Table 6.

The apparent surface of the daytime running lamp in the direction of its axis of reference shall be not less than 25 cm² and not more than 200 cm²; when type approved as a lamp marked "D", the apparent surface shall not be more than 100 cm².
For measurement of the daytime running lamp (RL), no additional requirements apply.
The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to the heat resistance test specified in Annex 6.
The failure provisions of paragraph 4.6. shall apply to the daytime running lamp (RL).
The colour of the light emitted by the daytime running lamp shall be white.
